about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for t_176d9d85 (follow-ups I3 and boundary from the t_fcf77055 review; decision rows 430/461/548). `darkroom.nudge` journalled `dt.gui.action`'s `status` (a normalised 0..1 slider position, design 7.3) as the key's value, so a later write's undo could restore exposure to a slider position; and a nudge at a real limit raised a CommitTimeout whose fix text said to retry. Run by tests/intent/test_nudge_undo_journal_intent.py (tests/test_nudge_undo_journal.py carries the wider suite).
